description: This Java class 'CustomResourceLoader' is responsible for loading message resource bundles from the file system, supporting internationalization by managing locale-specific messages for the OpenMRS web application.

classes.name: CustomResourceLoader
classes.description: Manages loading of resource bundles for different locales from properties files, providing singleton access and locale-based resource retrieval.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CustomResourceLoader, initializing it with the given HTTP request if necessary.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the resource bundle associated with a specific locale.

methods.name: parseLocaleFrom
methods.description: Parses and derives a Locale object from a filename string based on a given basename.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the map containing Locale keys and ResourceBundle values.

methods.name: getAvailablelocales
methods.description: Returns the set of locales supported by the resource loader.
